title: Alkermes to Participate in the Goldman Sachs 47th Annual Global Healthcare Conference
summary: DUBLIN --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jun. 3, 2026-- Alkermes plc (Nasdaq: ALKS) announced today that management will participate in a fireside chat at the Goldman Sachs 47 th Annual Global Healthcare Conference on Wednesday, June 10, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ET ( 3:00 p.m. BST).
body_markdown:
DUBLIN--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jun. 3, 2026--[Alkermes plc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.alkermes.com&esheet=54546911&newsitemid=20260603267022&lan=en-US&anchor=Alkermes+plc&index=1&md5=f93d33fa848b8a78425961aa2c962411) (Nasdaq: ALKS) announced today that management will participate in a fireside chat at the Goldman Sachs 47th Annual Global Healthcare Conference on Wednesday, June 10, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ET (3:00 p.m. BST). The live webcast may be accessed under the Investors tab on[www.alkermes.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.alkermes.com%2F&esheet=54546911&newsitemid=20260603267022&lan=en-US&anchor=www.alkermes.com&index=2&md5=cad77ab9dcc1ace74dc575e6cf6a31eb) and will be archived for 14 days.


**About Alkermes plc** Alkermes plc (Nasdaq: ALKS), a mid-cap growth and value equity, is a global biopharmaceutical company that seeks to develop innovative medicines in the field of neuroscience. The company has a portfolio of proprietary commercial products for the treatment of alcohol dependence, opioid dependence, schizophrenia, bipolar I disorder and narcolepsy. Alkermes’ pipeline includes late-stage clinical candidates in development for narcolepsy and idiopathic hypersomnia, and orexin 2 receptor agonists in early clinical development for other neurological disorders, including attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and fatigue associated with multiple sclerosis and Parkinson’s disease. Headquartered in Ireland, Alkermes also has a corporate office and research and development center in Massachusetts and a manufacturing facility in Ohio. For more information, please visit Alkermes’ website at[www.alkermes.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.alkermes.com&esheet=54546911&newsitemid=20260603267022&lan=en-US&anchor=www.alkermes.com&index=3&md5=43a451f2ebc64587bd1a6d116d33e4f7) .
